newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's first divorcee dies after marriage.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's first divorcee dies after marriage.

text.p: A terminally-ill man who became Ireland's first divorcee through a court case has died 10 days after remarrying, the Irish media reported on Saturday.
It said the unnamed man, who was in his 60s, married the woman with whom he had been living for several years at a ceremony in his home after winning the first legal divorce.
Divorce is due to be legalised in Ireland this month after a wafer-thin majority voted to allow remarriage in a referendum.

But the man, who had been separated for his wife for several years, appealed to the High Court to be granted a divorce before the law came into effect saying the delay infringed his constitutional rights.
He took court action to ensure that he could remarry before his death.
